description: Minimal capability set. With one exception the frontend reaches the outside world only through this app's own #[tauri::command] functions, so no filesystem, shell or HTTP plugin permissions are granted — every side effect goes through Rust code that enforces timeouts, PATH resolution and config trust. The exception is `dialog:allow-open`, which backs two pickers: the Browse… button in Add a repository, and the + button in an agent composer. Both show an OS picker and return only the paths the user chose in it — no directory listing, no file read, and no access to anything not explicitly selected. A repository path is then validated by the same `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` a typed path goes through, and a composer path is only ever inserted into the message box as text for the user to review before sending. So this is a convenience over typing a path rather than a way around the checks on one. `dialog:default` is deliberately not used, because it would also grant save dialogs and the native message/ask/confirm prompts, none of which this app has any use for. Note that file drag-and-drop onto the composer needs no permission here at all: it rides `core:event:default` via the window's own `tauri://drag-drop` event, which is why `dragDropEnabled` is true in tauri.conf.json.
